tashkent-international-financial-centre.title: Tashkent International Financial Centre: The 2026 Constitutional Law
tashkent-international-financial-centre.description: A neutral analysis of the Constitutional Law establishing the Tashkent International Financial Centre — its common-law legal architecture, the 2076 tax exemption and its Pillar Two limits, the operational regime, and how it compares to DIFC, ADGM, AIFC, and QFC.

outsourcing-operational-activities.title: Outsourcing Operational Activities in Uzbekistan
outsourcing-operational-activities.description: A practical overview of the regulatory framework governing outsourcing arrangements in Uzbekistan, including permitted structures, labour implications, and contract requirements.

accounting-policy-tax-purposes.title: Accounting Policy for Tax Purposes in Uzbekistan
accounting-policy-tax-purposes.description: How Uzbekistan's tax code governs accounting method elections, asset classification, and timing differences — with practical guidance for foreign-invested entities.

franchising-uzbekistan.title: Franchising in Uzbekistan: Legal Framework & Entry Structures
franchising-uzbekistan.description: An analysis of Uzbekistan's franchising legislation, registration obligations, royalty repatriation rules, and key contractual considerations for international franchisors.

payroll-social-contributions.title: Payroll & Social Contributions: Employer Obligations in Uzbekistan
payroll-social-contributions.description: A structured breakdown of employer payroll obligations — personal income tax withholding, social insurance contributions, reporting deadlines, and penalties for non-compliance.

escrow-accounts-uzbekistan.title: Escrow Accounts in Uzbekistan: Legal Mechanics & Use Cases
escrow-accounts-uzbekistan.description: An overview of escrow account regulation in Uzbekistan, covering permitted use cases in M&A and real estate transactions, bank requirements, and release mechanics.

creative-industry-park-uzbekistan.title: Creative Industry Park: Uzbekistan's Framework for Creative Economy
creative-industry-park-uzbekistan.description: A detailed guide to the Creative Industry Park regime — eligibility criteria, tax incentives, registration process, and operational requirements for qualifying entities.

online-gambling-uzbekistan.title: Online Gambling Regulation in Uzbekistan
online-gambling-uzbekistan.description: The regulatory landscape for online gambling operators in Uzbekistan — licensing requirements, permitted game types, technical standards, and AML compliance obligations.

permanent-establishment-uzbekistan.title: Permanent Establishment Risk in Uzbekistan
permanent-establishment-uzbekistan.description: An in-depth analysis of permanent establishment triggers under Uzbek tax law and applicable tax treaties, with structuring strategies to mitigate PE exposure.

self-employment-uzbekistan.title: Self-Employment Regime in Uzbekistan
self-employment-uzbekistan.description: A practical guide to Uzbekistan's self-employment tax regime — eligibility, registration, contribution rates, and implications for businesses engaging independent contractors.

crypto-asset-service-providers-uzbekista.title: Crypto-Asset Service Providers: Licensing in Uzbekistan
crypto-asset-service-providers-uzbekista.description: Uzbekistan's framework for crypto-asset service providers — NAFS licensing requirements, permitted activities, capital requirements, and AML/KYC obligations.

licensing-procedures-uzbekistan.title: Licensing Procedures for Regulated Activities in Uzbekistan
licensing-procedures-uzbekistan.description: A sector-by-sector overview of licensing requirements in Uzbekistan, covering financial services, healthcare, construction, education, and media — with application timelines.

special-economic-zones-uzbekistan.title: Special Economic Zones in Uzbekistan: A Comparative Guide
special-economic-zones-uzbekistan.description: A comparative analysis of Uzbekistan's SEZ landscape — free economic zones, small industrial zones, and IT parks — covering incentive packages, entry criteria, and operational constraints.

accounting-law-uzbekistan.title: Accounting Law in Uzbekistan: Key Requirements for Businesses
accounting-law-uzbekistan.description: An overview of Uzbekistan's accounting legislation — mandatory chart of accounts, financial statement requirements, audit thresholds, and transition considerations for IFRS adoption.

representative-offices-uzbekistan.title: Representative Offices in Uzbekistan: Registration & Compliance
representative-offices-uzbekistan.description: A practical guide to establishing and operating a foreign representative office in Uzbekistan — accreditation procedures, permitted activities, tax treatment, and staffing rules.

voluntary-liquidation-uzbekistan.title: Voluntary Liquidation of Companies in Uzbekistan
voluntary-liquidation-uzbekistan.description: Step-by-step guidance on voluntary liquidation procedures for LLCs and JSCs in Uzbekistan — from board resolution through creditor notification to final deregistration.

pit-refunds-education-uzbekistan.title: PIT Refunds for Education Expenses in Uzbekistan
pit-refunds-education-uzbekistan.description: A guide to the personal income tax deduction and refund mechanism for education expenses in Uzbekistan — eligible institutions, claim procedures, and documentation requirements.

employer-of-record-central-asia.title: Employer of Record in Central Asia: A Practical Overview
employer-of-record-central-asia.description: How EOR structures operate across Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, and Kyrgyzstan — legal foundations, risk allocation, onboarding timelines, and cost benchmarks for international employers.

islamic-finance-uzbekistan.title: Islamic Finance in Uzbekistan: A Practical Guide
islamic-finance-uzbekistan.description: Uzbekistan's Islamic finance framework explained — from the legislative foundation and permitted MFO instruments to Special Council requirements and Sharia-compliant penalty mechanics.
